item.title: Chris Paul, the ‘Point God,’ retires as All-Star weekend begins, ending a 21-season NBA run
item.description: Chris Paul, the “Point God” who was a 12-time All-Star selection and two-time Olympic gold medalist, announced his retirement on Friday in the capper of a 21-season career that will surely merit induction into the Basketball Hall of Fame.
